page.overview:
What is Birth Island?

Birth Island is one of the Sevii Islands and is the home to the Mythical Pokémon Deoxys in FireRed, LeafGreen and Emerald.

To get to Birth Island, the player character needs the Aurora Ticket event item. This item is sometimes called Nine Island because it is the ninth in the chain of islands which make up the Sevii Islands. The player character can go here via the Seagallop dock in Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen and the S.S Tidal in Pokémon Emerald. Once the player character arrives on Birth Island, they have to rotate a stone triangle positioned in the center until it glows bright red. However, if the player character stops moving the triangle, it will immediately reset and the player character will have to begin again. When it glows red, Deoxys will appear before the player character (Attack Forme in Pokémon FireRed, Speed Forme in Pokémon Emerald and Defense Forme in Pokémon LeafGreen).
